name: cx-rules-only~p1
task: Never pick up the box in the other room. Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed, and whenever you hold the key, try to have the door open then or open it later.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The hard Absence(target_picked_up) matches “Never pick up the box.” The soft Absence(key_lost) captures the preference not to drop the key while the door is closed, and the soft Response(has_door_key, door_open) captures the preference to open the door while holding the key or later. These are rules, not goals, so the empty FINAL_STATES is valid.

texts: Never pick up the mission's box.
Do not drop the key while the door is closed.
Whenever the matching key is held, the door should be open then or opened later.
